description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Senior District Manager role will lead our Acquisition Sales Team for Sweden, Finland and Baltics. It is a unique opportunity to shape and execute the Go-To-Market strategy and drive high visibility, high impact projects at a very exciting time for the company.

Snowflake is an innovative, high-growth, customer-focused company operating in a large and expanding market. The Senior District Manager will play a key role in driving new-business acquisition, expanding regional market presence and building and scaling a high-performing sales organisation across multiple countries.

This role requires an experienced sales leader with a proven track record of building and scaling acquisition teams, consistently exceeding sales quotas and managing complex sales processes. The successful candidate will demonstrate strong strategic thinking, commercial judgement, leadership capability and the ability to operate independently while driving regional sales performance.

AS A SENIOR DISTRICT MANAGER YOU WILL:

  • Have an in-depth understanding on Snowflake's product in order to be able to provide guidance on selling, navigating complex legal negotiations, helping eliminate technical barriers, managing escalations

  • Lead, recruit and build a high-performing Acquisition Sales Team, with responsibility for developing, coaching, motivating and scaling the organisation to support regional growth and deliver commercial objectives.

  • Enable, coach, develop and motivate a robust field sales team, establishing high standards of performance, accountability and sales execution, while developing individual and team capabilities to achieve and exceed sales targets.

  • Scale and develop territories across Sweden, Finland and the Baltics through strategic planning, effective account allocation and prioritisation of new-business acquisition opportunities, ensuring resources are aligned with regional growth objectives.

  • Navigate complex legal negotiations and help eliminate technical barriers, coordinating internal expertise and resources to progress strategic opportunities and achieve successful commercial outcomes

  • Champion a PG Culture, Sales Process Excellence, Continuous MEDDPICC qualification execution during sales cycle

  • Raise the standard of every sales deliverable, including first meetings, executive presentations, business cases and customer engagement, ensuring the team effectively communicates Snowflake’s value proposition to senior decision-makers.

  • Ensure customers are positioned for success by identifying and developing high-impact use cases that deliver tangible business value and support long-term customer relationships.

  • Manage predictable sales forecasting and regular account and pipeline review meetings with the Regional Vice President, providing clear visibility of regional performance, opportunities, risks and actions required to achieve commercial objectives.

  • Develop and maintain strong senior relationships across the regional partner network, including systems integrators and ecosystem partners, to support market development, customer acquisition and regional growth.

  • Develop, own and implement country-level Go-To-Market strategies across Sweden, Finland and the Baltics, translating business priorities into actionable plans that drive new-business acquisition, territory development and sustainable revenue growth.

AS A SENIOR DISTRICT MANAGER, YOU WILL HAVE:

  • BA/BS required

  • A proven ability to independently manage, develop and close new-client relationships, with a strong focus on new-business sales and the management of complex enterprise sales processes.

  • A proven track record of building, developing and scaling new-business acquisition sales teams across the Nordics: Sweden and Finland (expected), and the Baltics (desirable).

  • Strong experience in frontline sales leadership, including responsibility for leading, coaching, developing and managing sales teams to achieve business objectives and deliver strong commercial performance.

  • A consistent track record of exceeding sales quotas as a sales leader, demonstrating the ability to drive team performance, deliver against revenue targets and achieve sustained commercial results.

  • The ability to manage, motivate and develop sales professionals, establish high-performance standards and create a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • A proactive, independent mindset, with the ability to exercise sound judgement, take ownership of regional priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth business environment.

  • The ability to think strategically and understand the bigger picture, including market dynamics, customer requirements and the commercial drivers influencing regional business performance.

  • Strong presentation, communication, negotiation, organisational and contact management skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and manage C-level Engagements and partner relationships.

  • The ability to navigate complex sales cycles, coordinate cross-functional resources, resolve commercial and technical challenges, and translate regional strategy into effective sales execution.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com
